summary: Phase 8/9 (Commercial Differentiation + Evidence-Based Development) verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 unit tests in test_iter95_differentiation.py + 14/14 new HTTP integration tests in test_iter158_differentiation_http.py all pass (22/22 = 100%). GET /api/performance/verified returns full attestation object (payload_hash 64-hex, signature 64-hex, key_id=perf-hmac-v1, algo=HMAC-SHA256(canonical-JSON), signed_at); regression fields (overall, equity_curve, accounts, integrity, generated_at) intact. POST /api/public/performance/verify works unauthenticated: returns valid=true for legitimate attestation and valid=false for tampered payload_hash or wrong signature. Public share flow: POST /performance/share → GET /public/performance/{share_id} (masked labels ACCOUNT-N, attestation attached and re-verifies OK) → DELETE /performance/share → follow-up GET returns 404. Evidence board returns exactly 6 features (execution_timing, adaptive_exits, regime_gating, dynamic_allocation, risk_layers, learning_pipeline); summary counts sum to 6; principle string present; days param clamped 1..365 (days=0 → 1, days=99999 → 365); requires auth. Broker intel: every row includes certification{tier,detail} with tier ∈ {CERTIFIED, ACCEPTABLE, DEGRADED, PROVISIONAL}. /broker-intel/certification returns brokers list + tiers legend dict with all 4 tier keys. Frontend: /performance shows attestation-seal, clicking attestation-verify-btn produces attestation-valid badge with text 'SIGNATURE VALID — TRACK RECORD IS TAMPER-FREE'. /agents renders evidence-board with all 6 evidence-<feature> rows and evidence-verdict-<feature> badges; evidence-summary shows '2 PROVEN 4 EXPERIMENTAL' matching backend live data (dynamic_allocation N=490 PROVEN, learning_pipeline N=1 PROVEN, others experimental — regime_gating N=0 expected per problem statement). BrokerIntelCard with broker-cert-<account_id> PROVISIONAL badges renders on /brokers (5 badges for all 5 accounts).

critical_code_review_comments: differentiation.perf_attestation uses os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] as fallback signing key — if JWT_SECRET is ever rotated, all previously-signed public attestations become unverifiable retroactively (the signed_at timestamp is inside the wrapper, not the payload). Consider making PERF_SIGNING_KEY a mandatory separate secret with its own rotation policy and embedding key_id (already present) into the verification lookup so old keys can still verify historical shares.

public_performance() masks labels but the equity_curve and integrity block leak absolute net PnL, per-account net_pnl, deal counts, and dates — that IS the intent of a share link, but worth documenting so future changes don't accidentally strip masking off account labels while leaving PII in payload notes fields.

VerifyBody accepts arbitrary-length payload_hash / signature strings. Consider Pydantic constraints (constr(regex='^[0-9a-f]{64}$')) so obvious garbage 400s at the schema layer instead of returning valid=false.

evidence() clamps days to 1..365 but silently — an out-of-range request returns 200 with the clamped window. That's fine, but the response doesn't echo the requested vs applied value, so a client asking for 5000 days won't know it got 365. Minor UX.
seed_data_creation: None. HTTP tests use admin session, create + immediately revoke a share link (no residual docs). Unit tests use isolated UIDs (iter95-<uuid>) with own cleanup.
